info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get It Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The IT Management Retrieval API allows users to access specific operational data related to IT management by utilizing a parameterized approach. This endpoint is ideal for developers needing to query and retrieve detailed insights about IT operations, tailored by the specified 'param1'. Common use cases include performance monitoring, incident tracking, and resource management for IT professionals. This API enhances visibility into operational metrics, fostering informed decision-making across IT departments.

get.description: Fetches the details of the operational gateway with the specified resource ID. This endpoint provides access to essential information related to the operational gateway's functionality and status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve operational information from the specified gateway, allowing users to specify parameters for the operation.

200.description: The request was processed successfully and the response contains the requested data.
